name: studio-parallel-content-intelligence
description: Internal Studio Parallel Instagram content intelligence application

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @studio-parallel/domain && npm run build -w @studio-parallel/config
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @studio-parallel/worker && npm run build -w @studio-parallel/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently --names web,worker --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @studio-parallel/web" "npm run dev -w @studio-parallel/worker"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @studio-parallel/web
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @studio-parallel/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
